read_dictionary_file.description: Which data-dict.yaml files load from disk. A file without a top-level `tables` key gives the agent nothing to work from, and is almost always a mistake, like columns listed at the top level instead of under a table. An explicitly empty `tables` is accepted. Dictionaries built in memory are out of scope. Errors are pinned as reason slugs; the wording belongs to each language.

cases.name: tables are listed
cases.yaml:
tables:
  - name: hikes
    columns:
      - name: hike_name
        type: string

cases.name: columns at the top level
cases.yaml:
columns:
  - name: hike_name
    type: string
    description: Name of the hike

cases.name: prose without tables
cases.yaml:
name: hikes
description: Hikes in Shenandoah.
